context:

description: docs/operations/release-guide.md says to rename the release-accounting test literal (tests/unit/release/test_changelog_tag_guard.py::test_repo_release_accounting_matches_*) to the new version "at each cut", and the v0.4.2 handoff said to update the CHANGELOG footer links at cut time. Both are wrong for the release branch. check_release_accounting validates the version PyPI currently serves, so on the release PR the literal must stay at the published version and the [Unreleased] compare link must still start at that version's tag. Moving either at cut time fails the required test job. Both belong in the develop version-sync PR after publication, which is how #2669 did it. Fix the guide and the BenchBox release skill reference, and consider having update_version.py or a sync target move both so no one edits them by hand.
